summary: Added an early reply-to repo-chat session check in routeTelegramTextMessage so Telegram replies to known repo-chat messages dispatch directly to repo-chat before goal routing. Imported findRepoChatSessionByMessageId, kept shouldRouteTelegramTextToRepoChat unchanged, renamed the helper test for clarity, and added an integration test proving replies with a matching repo-chat session call repo-chat dispatch and do not invoke goal routing. Verification passed: pnpm vitest run src/telegram/bot-handlers.repo-chat-routing.test.ts src/telegram/repo-chat-commands.test.ts, pnpm build, and pnpm lint.
